title: geum geoides
intro: Geum geoides, commonly known as Avens, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in soothing digestive issues, reducing pain, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Geum geoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions also include anti-anxiety and anti-depressive properties, making it a potential natural remedy for stress relief and mood enhancement.
